title: Stability of Differential Stochastic Variational Inequalities with History-Dependent Responses and Transfer Learning
summary: In this paper, we propose and study a class of differential stochastic variational inequalities (DSVIs), in which an ordinary differential equation (ODE) is coupled with history-dependent stochastic variational inequalities (SVI). This framework models closed-loop stochastic systems with time-varying random equilibria and includes optimization-constrained ODEs as special cases.
